name: Sister Harassment♪
source: One night, the protagonist found out his little sister was masturbating while thinking about him. Hearing her sweet moans broke him and he ended up raping her. That marked the beginning of their forbidden love, but his classmate, Satsuki, found out about it soon after. She wanted to stop him from making a big mistake, but Ami thought that Satsuki was trying to steal him from her. That's how the two girls started fighting over the main character.
translation: 一天晚上，主角在想他的时候发现妹妹正在自慰。听到她甜美的呻吟声让他心碎，最后他强奸了她。这标志着他们禁忌之恋的开始，但不久之后他的同学小月就发现了这件事。她想阻止他犯下大错，但阿美认为小月想把他从她身边抢走。就这样，两个女孩开始争夺主角。
